title: Infernal Warhammer

sources.title: Infernal Weapon
markers: | description = On a hit, this weapon deals an additional {{DamageText|3|Poison}} damage and can possibly {{Cond|Poisoned|Poison}} its target.

summary: A +1 warhammer that adds 3 Poison damage and can Poison the target.

fields.Infernal Weapon: On a hit, deal 3 extra Poison and force a DC 12 Constitution save. Failure inflicts Poisoned for 2 turns, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. The pinned source reports the save is hidden regardless of outcome.
fields.Base value: 310 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Source note: The primary source labels this weapon one-handed but also gives an unverified versatile damage value.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Separated the contradictory handedness source fields. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
